text: Kofi and Isabel got engaged over the weekend! He proposed on the beach in Cornwall. Wedding probably sometime next summer.
Efua's cat Biscuit has a kidney infection and is on antibiotics. She's really worried about him. I should text her on Friday to see how he's doing.
Lior picked up the new puppy yesterday, a cocker spaniel called Pepper. Apparently she cried all night.
Need to buy a card for Connor and Duc's tenth anniversary. It's next Tuesday.
Called Asha. Her sister Shreya is getting married in early March and Asha is the maid of honour. She's nervous about the speech already.
Kai said his dog Rolo turns five this weekend and they're doing a little party in the park with a dog-friendly cake. Ridiculous, but lovely.

Blessing mentioned her parents' fortieth anniversary is at the end of the month. She and her brother Mateo are organising a surprise dinner for them at the Ghanaian place in Peckham, with about thirty guests, some flying in from Accra. Her mum suspects nothing so far. Blessing asked if I could make a photo slideshow, so I need to collect pictures from her by next weekend.
Pick up the dry cleaning and drop the parcel at the post office tomorrow.
Khadija is allergic to nuts, so no satay at the dinner on Saturday.
Laila's engagement party has been called off. She and Jonah split up last week. Don't forget to check in with her sometime next week, gently.

Irina's grandmother passed away on Sunday. They were very close; Irina spent every summer with her as a kid. The funeral is in Bucharest, probably next Thursday, and Irina flies out on Monday with her brother Louis. She's not sure how long she'll be away, maybe a fortnight. Must send flowers to her flat before she goes.
Yasmin's rabbit, Clover, had to have an operation on her teeth this morning. Yasmin sounded shattered.
Louis is a vet nurse at the practice on Hill Road. Says he'd love a pair of decent running shoes for his birthday, hint hint.

Rafael and Elif are celebrating their first wedding anniversary in a fortnight. They're going to Lisbon for four days, and Elif has secretly booked a fado night. Rafael doesn't know yet. They're leaving their dog, Olive, with Elif's mum, who is already spoiling her rotten.

Wei told me Gareth has finally proposed to Nina! He did it on Friday night at the restaurant where they had their first date, and apparently he was so nervous he dropped the ring under the table. The wedding is going to be small, maybe over the summer, somewhere in the Lakes. Nina wants me to do a reading, which is terrifying.
Remind me to ring Adriana on Wednesday evening. Her dog went missing on Monday and they still haven't found him.
Mariam is fostering two kittens until the end of November. One is grey and one is ginger, both completely feral.
Catalina's daughter starts reception next September. Catalina already sounds anxious about it, bless her.
Erin and her husband are renewing their vows in Galway in early June for their twentieth anniversary. She asked if I'd come. I said yes, so I need to sort flights soon.
Magda has been really struggling since her cat Bella was put to sleep on Tuesday. Bella was nineteen. I should pop round with some cake this weekend.
Booked the boiler service for next Wednesday morning, between eight and twelve.
Alina says her parrot, Kiwi, has learned to say her husband's name and nothing else. Their kids think it's the funniest thing ever.

Hannah's brother Kai is getting married to Ciara on the 14th of next month. Hannah is doing all the flowers herself and is quietly panicking, because the florist she'd lined up as backup has just closed. Their mum is making the cake, and their dad keeps rewriting his speech. Ciara wants peonies, which won't be in season. I should offer to help Hannah on the Friday before.
Duc is vegetarian now. Also very into bouldering lately.

Lunch with Isabel today. She and Kofi have found a venue for the wedding, a barn near Ludlow, and they're aiming for late September next year. Her dad is paying for the bar, which is apparently a big deal in their family. She wants a hand with the invitations sometime after Christmas. Kofi is mostly in charge of the music, which worries her.
Connor's new puppy arrives on Saturday. A black lab, not named yet. He's taking the whole of next week off to settle her in.
Text Efua tomorrow about whether Biscuit's blood results came back.
Shreya's hen do is the second weekend of February in Bath. Asha is organising it and asked for ideas. Spa day seems like the obvious winner.
Elif mentioned that Rafael has always wanted a proper coffee machine. Might be a good anniversary present idea if she asks.
Gareth Williams from next door, Gaz to everyone on the street, said his old collie Bramble is losing her sight. He's taking her to a specialist on Thursday.
Blessing's brother Mateo got engaged to his girlfriend Laila at the weekend! Blessing says their mum cried for an hour. I must send them both a congratulations card.
Nothing much from the coffee with Lior. Mostly talked about the weather and the trains.
Irina's back from Romania. She seems okay but tired. Her mum is staying with her until the end of the month.
Yasmin's niece Nina has her first birthday party on Sunday afternoon. Yasmin asked me to bring the bubble machine.
Wei's wife is expecting their second baby in early April. Wei is thrilled, but she has awful morning sickness this time round.
Kofi Osei is now officially the head of design at his agency. He found out on Monday. Need to message him to say congratulations.
Adriana's dog was found! A woman two streets away had him in her garden for three days. Should send Adriana a little treat for him.
Car MOT on Friday, then the vet with our cat at four. Cancel the gym.

Khadija and her husband Louis have just adopted a retired greyhound called Dash. He's terrified of the stairs, won't go near the washing machine, and sleeps in the kitchen on a pile of old duvets. Their son is completely obsessed with him and reads him bedtime stories. Khadija says it's been a tough first week, but they're getting there. The rescue centre is doing a home check next Monday.
Ciara is a primary school teacher in Leeds and lives with her partner, Jonah, in a flat above a bakery. Loves cold-water swimming.
Called Mum's friend Mrs Kaur. Her husband had his hip replaced on Tuesday and he's home now but in a lot of pain. She'd love a visit next week, maybe Wednesday or Thursday.
Don't forget Kai's stag do is the weekend after next. I'm driving, so no drinking for me.
Catalina and Mateo celebrated their engagement anniversary last night. Apparently he forgot until about six o'clock and had to run out for flowers.

Erin's cat, Smudge, had six kittens on Saturday night under the spare bed, which nobody saw coming because they thought she'd been spayed. Erin's keeping two, and she's trying to find homes for the other four by Christmas. Her husband is less enthusiastic. She asked if I knew anyone. Maybe Duc? He's been talking about getting a cat for ages.
Magda's daughter Alina has her driving test next Friday morning. Third attempt, and she's really nervous. Remind me to text Alina good luck on Thursday night.
Lior's sister got married in Tel Aviv last weekend. He showed me photos. Looked incredible.
Remember to ask Connor how the puppy training classes went. They started on Tuesday.
Hannah Le said her dad retires at the end of the year after thirty-five years at the council. There's a do for him in mid-December, and she wants us all to come.
Rafael is a nurse on the night shift at St Thomas'. Hates mornings, understandably.

Kofi and Isabel postponed the engagement party until spring because her grandad has been unwell. Isabel is pretty upset about it. His surgery is sometime next week. I should ring her afterwards to see how he's doing.
Need to get Asha something small for her thirtieth on Saturday. She mentioned wanting a new plant for the bathroom, and she loves anything yellow.
Gareth and Nina had their engagement photos taken on Sunday. Nina's sister Mariam took them, and they're gorgeous.
Book a table for two for Friday night, somewhere quiet. Our anniversary.
Shreya's cockapoo Mango had his first birthday yesterday. She bought him a pup cup and a squeaky hedgehog, and he destroyed the hedgehog in under a minute.
Efua and her partner Blessing are moving to Bristol at the end of March. Efua starts a new job at the university there in April, and Blessing is going freelance. They're taking the cat, obviously.

Spoke to Uncle Duc on the phone this evening. His knee is still bad and he's waiting for an appointment sometime in the new year. Auntie Elif says he's grumpy but fine. Their granddaughter graduates from Manchester in July, and they're already planning the trip up.
Yasmin mentioned her parents met at a wedding forty years ago this month. Thought that was sweet.
Wei's little boy turns four on Wednesday. He's obsessed with dinosaurs, so a dinosaur book or a puzzle would go down well.

Long chat with Laila tonight. She's still not sleeping since the breakup and has moved back in with her mum for now. She's started seeing a counsellor, which is good. Her cat Pickle went with her, which helps. She's thinking about a trip to Portugal with her cousin Catalina over the summer to clear her head. I should check in again on Sunday, and maybe invite her round for dinner next week.
Alina's husband Jonah has been offered a promotion, but it means relocating to Glasgow sometime next year. They haven't decided yet. Alina's not keen.
